data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: sprint Phase E dispatch lacks a manifest (JSON in ARTIFACTS_DIR recording agent_id, expected_branch, worktree_path) and Phase F harvest lacks a pre-merge branch-context verification step. Classification: COMPLEX — touches Phase E + Phase F sprint orchestration, harvest-worktree.sh script, and a new manifest contract. Triage comment on the ticket explicitly flags this as safeguard-class (Rule 22) requiring user approval and brainstorm-level scoping. Per rule:no-safeguard-edits, leaving OPEN; user must explicitly approve before any code change. Recommend brainstorm-approved epic.
